summary: Frontend-only test of the redesigned SignaturePad activation toggle. Seeded localStorage (customer/project/settings) and navigated to /reports/edit?projectId=proj-test-1. Verified via DOM inspection + screenshots: (1) Initial state shows blue 'Unterschrift' button (#1976d2 = rgb(25,118,210)) with pencil icon and dimmed canvas (rgba(248,250,252,0.4) overlay) — PASS. (2) Tap 'Unterschrift' → button becomes green 'Fertig' (#16a34a = rgb(22,163,74)) with checkmark-circle icon, canvas background turns light blue (#f0f9ff = rgb(240,249,255)), border becomes blue (rgb(25,118,210)), placeholder text changes to 'Jetzt hier unterschreiben' — PASS. (3) Tap 'Fertig' → button reverts to 'Unterschrift', canvas dims again — PASS. (4) Two independent SignaturePads (Kunde + Handwerker) — activating one does NOT activate the other (after Kunde was activated then deactivated, both still show 'Unterschrift', and screenshot confirmed only Kunde canvas was blue-bordered) — PASS. (5) CRITICAL FAILURE: Parent ScrollView does NOT lock when pad is active. Mouse-wheel scroll over the active canvas scrolled the page from scrollTop=1600 to scrollTop=1900 — confirming scrollEnabled is still TRUE while isActive=true. Root cause: integration in /app/frontend/app/reports/edit.tsx is INVERTED — `onDrawingChange={setScrollEnabled}` on lines 1598 and 1615. SignaturePad fires onDrawingChange(true) when activating (meaning 'please block scroll'), but the parent then calls setScrollEnabled(true), which KEEPS scrolling enabled. Must be `onDrawingChange={(d) => setScrollEnabled(!d)}`. This is the central requirement of the redesign and is broken.

integration_issues.issue: Parent passes `onDrawingChange={setScrollEnabled}` (edit.tsx lines 1598 + 1615). SignaturePad fires onDrawingChange(true) on activate to request scroll-lock, but this directly sets scrollEnabled=TRUE (scroll stays enabled). Confirmed by wheel-scroll over active canvas: scrollTop 1600 → 1900 while isActive=true. Fix: `onDrawingChange={(isDrawing) => setScrollEnabled(!isDrawing)}` on BOTH SignaturePad instances. Also remove/invert the onFocus={() => setScrollEnabled(true)} on the name TextInputs (lines 1606, 1623) — they currently work only because the bug aligns by coincidence; with the fix, they should remain setScrollEnabled(true) which is still correct semantically (re-enable scroll when focusing name field).

issues: Touch target: Unterschrift/Fertig button is ~32px tall (paddingVertical:6 in styles.button) — below the 44px iOS minimum. Same issue noted in iteration_14.

Without this, the entire redesign’s scroll-lock contract is broken.

critical_code_review_comments: edit.tsx still 2727 lines (>700) — recommend splitting into sub-components (SignaturesSection, EmployeesSection, etc.) for maintainability.

SignaturePad.tsx: the onDrawingChange contract is now overloaded — it fires (true) both when panResponder starts a stroke AND when the Unterschrift button is tapped. The parent must treat (true)=lock-scroll, (false)=unlock-scroll. The current wiring in edit.tsx misuses this contract (passes setScrollEnabled directly), which is the root cause of the reported bug.
Inactive overlay correctly uses pointerEvents='none' so the underlying ScrollView receives the touch/wheel events — this is correct, but only works once scrollEnabled is properly false when active.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: /app/frontend/app/reports/edit.tsx lines 1598 and 1615 pass `onDrawingChange={setScrollEnabled}` to SignaturePad. The SignaturePad’s contract is onDrawingChange(true)=‘I’m active/drawing, please block parent scroll’; onDrawingChange(false)=‘I’m inactive, please re-enable scroll’. The parent state variable is `scrollEnabled` and is consumed by <ScrollView scrollEnabled={scrollEnabled}>. Therefore the boolean must be INVERTED: setScrollEnabled(!isDrawing). The current wiring sends true when scroll should be false (and vice versa). Reproduction: navigate to /reports/edit?projectId=proj-test-1, scroll to Unterschriften section, tap blue 'Unterschrift' button (it correctly turns green 'Fertig' and the canvas highlights), then mouse-wheel over the canvas — the page still scrolls. Expected: the page should NOT scroll while a pad is active. Mitigation (one-line change): `onDrawingChange={(d) => setScrollEnabled(!d)}` on both <SignaturePad …/> usages.
